record.notes: Abstract gives a lower bound ('>') for the conductivity; the superscript exponent is lost in PDF extraction, so the value reads as 5x10-3 S/cm but is copied as '510-3'. The 500 °C value is from the abstract; the 0.55 eV activation energy is for the thin film per Section 3.2 (in-plane conductivity of the film, not a bulk value). Measurement range 400–750 °C in synthetic air. The 94.4% density is from the thin-film SEM estimate in Section 3.2 and the 750 °C/6 h is the film calcination.
